Falcons vs Saints DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, October 5 · NFL Week 4 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 5, 7:23 PM ET

Bijan Robinson has the highest SPAGS projection in the Falcons at Saints DraftKings Showdown: 22.9 points at $11,800 FLEX, 34.3 at captain for $17,700. Across 100,000 simulations Robinson holds 70% of the winning-lineup credit.

He also has the largest captain share: 24.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Robinson at captain. Chris Olave is the next captain in line, at 15.4%. The model gives him 10.6 targets on 37.0 routes.

New Orleans is a 1.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.5 for the Saints and 23 for the Falcons.

Behind Robinson and Olave, the next projections are Tyler Shough (19.4, $9,600), Drake London (17.2, $10,000) and Michael Penix Jr. (15.9, $9,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 5, 7:23 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 24.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 22.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 34.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.2 carries and 5.3 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Robinson averaged 22.9 points with a simulated floor of 11.5 and a ceiling of 39.0. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 24.1% as the captain and 45.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Chris Olave, NO WR ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Chris Olave holds 15.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 19.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 10.6 targets on 37.0 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Olave averaged 19.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.9 and a ceiling of 39.7. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.4% as the captain and 38.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Tyler Shough, NO QB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Tyler Shough holds 15.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,400 and the 19.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Shough averaged 19.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 35.8. He holds 66% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.2% as the captain and 50.5% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Falcons vs Saints

Drake London, ATL WR ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Drake London carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 17.2 DraftKings points for a $10,000 FLEX salary ($15,000 at captain). The model gives him 7.7 targets on 22.1 routes. Across 100,000 simulations London averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 5.7 and a ceiling of 38.5. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.6% as the captain and 32.2% in a FLEX spot.

Michael Penix Jr., ATL QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Michael Penix Jr. carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.9 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). Across 100,000 simulations Penix averaged 15.9 points with a simulated floor of 6.2 and a ceiling of 29.2. He holds 50% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.8% as the captain and 44.6% in a FLEX spot.

Juwan Johnson, NO TE ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Juwan Johnson carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.9 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 6.5 targets on 33.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Johnson averaged 13.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.9 and a ceiling of 28.2. He holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.1% as the captain and 29.6% in a FLEX spot.

Alvin Kamara, NO RB ($7,000 FLEX / $10,500 CPT)

Alvin Kamara carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.3 DraftKings points for a $7,000 FLEX salary ($10,500 at captain). The model gives him 12.0 carries and 2.9 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Kamara averaged 11.3 points with a simulated floor of 6.0 and a ceiling of 18.6. He holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.7% as the captain and 28.5% in a FLEX spot.

Bryce Lance projects for 4.7 DraftKings points at a $1,800 FLEX salary, 2.62 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.0 targets on 25.5 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Lance averaged 4.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.1. He holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.7% as the captain and 16.4% in a FLEX spot.

Bijan Robinson leads the SPAGS model at 22.9 DraftKings points for $11,800 at FLEX, or 34.3 points at captain for $17,700.

Bijan Robinson is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 27 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Bryce Lance (4.7 points at $1,800), Daniel Carlson (9.3 points at $4,800) and Jahan Dotson (5.8 points at $3,000).

The Saints are a 1.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 47.5, with implied team totals of 24.5 for the Saints and 23 for the Falcons.
